category_title: Socially isolated children with low self-confidence and resilience
minimal_context: Catriona is participating in an initial whole class philosophical inquiry session using the 'Laura and Paul' text.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's begin our whole class discussion on the 'Laura and Paul' text. Does anyone have a question or idea to start us off?

STUDENT: (Sits quietly next to her allocated buddy, listening attentively to the others but not volunteering any questions or ideas.)

TUTOR: Catriona, what do you think about the story?

STUDENT: Um... I just think Laura is nice. My buddy is nice too.

TUTOR: Can you explain how that fits with what the rest of the class is discussing?

STUDENT: (Looks down, refusing to take an active role in the whole class discussion, and turns to speak only to her buddy instead) I don't know... I don't want to say anything else.

options.A: Take responsibility as the facilitator to ensure a balanced dialogue occurs during the CoPI sessions, exploring as many perspectives as possible.
options.B: Teach the student to utilize strengths, decode social cues, and recognize internal and external emotional states during the whole class discussions.
options.C: Observe occurrences of the target behavior during the CoPI sessions, recording the data in scatter plots and ABC charts after the discussion finishes.
options.D: Adjust the ratio of lower-level to higher-level questions during the CoPI sessions based on the student's reading level of the stimulus text.
